data.description:
# Problem

`rebar.similar.index.validity_key(embedding_model, digest_prompt_commit)` folds the
embedding model together with `embedding.DIGEST_PROMPT_COMMIT` — a hand-written commit
string — to decide when a stored vector is still comparable.

The prompt text it is meant to identify does NOT live at that commit. It is vendored
into `embedding.DIGEST_PROMPT`. Nothing holds the two in step, so editing the prompt
without also moving the pin leaves every stored vector describing text the tier no
longer produces, and `unvectored_ids` keeps reporting the corpus as covered. The
failure is silent: ranking still returns results, they are just computed against
stale text.

This is not hypothetical. The vendored prompt ALREADY deviates from `f147e08242f` in
four places (discovered while remediating 2041's code review), one of which — appending
", as JSON" to the final instruction — changes what the model emits. The pin asserted
an identity the text did not have, and only a line-by-line diff against the commit
surfaced it.

# Approach

Fold a hash of the shipped `DIGEST_PROMPT` into the key material so the identity is
computed from the artifact rather than asserted alongside it. Keep the commit pin as
human-readable provenance; it stops being load-bearing.

Preserve `validity_key`'s two-argument shape and its "one opaque digest, not two
columns" docstring rationale — the change is to what the second argument is derived
from, not to the function's design.

`tests/unit/test_similar_tickets_index.py::test_changing_the_pinned_digest_prompt_commit_invalidates_them_likewise`
monkeypatches `DIGEST_PROMPT_COMMIT` and asserts invalidation. If callers switch to a
value computed at import time, that monkeypatch no longer reaches it, so the test must
be reworked to exercise the new derivation rather than deleted.

# Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Editing `DIGEST_PROMPT` by one character, with `DIGEST_PROMPT_COMMIT` unchanged,
      produces a different validity key. A test pins this.
- [ ] Changing `embedding_model` still produces a different key (existing behaviour,
      still covered).
- [ ] The reworked `test_changing_the_pinned_digest_prompt_commit_invalidates_them_likewise`
      asserts against the derivation actually in use, and fails if the prompt hash is
      dropped from the key material.
- [ ] No vector built before this change is read under its old key: the derivation
      change invalidates them, which is the intended behaviour and is asserted.
- [ ] `make verify` passes.

# Out of scope

Re-aligning `DIGEST_PROMPT` to `f147e08242f`. The four deviations are deliberate and
are now documented at the definition site; three of them correct statements that became
false when the overlap subsystem was deleted.
data.title: Derive the similar-ticket validity key from the digest prompt text, not a commit pin
